Ellen — thanks for the clear asks. Below is a condensed cost assertion and a proposed evaluation plan we can fold into the MAP. I attached a workbook with the sensitivity tabs.

Top-line cost assertion (pilot profile):
- Avg request pattern: 4 calls/user/day, average user session 2.5 prompts.
- Avg tokens per call: 120 (prompt 60 / completion 60).
- Expected cacheable prefix rate (KV/prefix caching): 28% 
- Batch size target in production (continuous batching): 6 requests per micro-batch at 150ms batching window
- Throughput target for pilot: 50 QPS peak, sustained 15 QPS
- Price estimate (hosted): $0.0018 per 1k tokens (model + infra blended) -> baseline tokens/$ = 555,555 tokens per $1

Sensitivity examples (see attached spreadsheet):
- With 28% cache hit and batching=6 -> effective tokens/$ ~ 720k (due to fewer forward tokens and GPU efficiency).
- If cache hit drops to 10% and batching window tightened (batch=2) -> tokens/$ falls to ~420k.

Evaluation plan (2-week pilot cadence):
- Week 0 (preflight): ingest traffic profile, confirm tokenization and sample prompts (3 days).
- Week 1: run A/B eval vs baseline for quality (ROUGE/QA pass rate), collect latency percentiles and token counts (5 days).
- Week 2: stress + capex validation (capacity tests for 50 QPS peak), finalize MAP acceptance criteria (2 days).

Acceptance criteria (proposed):
- P95 generation latency <= 300ms for 95% of requests at pilot profile
- Average cost per logical request <= $0.025 (including infra & inference)
- No model-quality regression on our 500-prompt eval suite (precision >= 95% vs baseline)

Attachments: starlite_token_econ_assumptions.xlsx (breakouts and sensitivity tabs), starlite_map_v1.pdf (MAP timeline and owners).

If this looks good I'll slot Marissa and Ben to run the ops verification. I also included a quick runbook note on safe fallbacks (lighter-quantized variant + caching first).

—Jonas
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Ellen — adding operational detail from our side. Ben, could you validate the throughput assumptions and confirm whether burst capacity will be needed for week-1 stress tests?

Key ops clarifications (short):
- Prefetch / KV caching: our conservative default is 25–30% for templated flows. If your flows are highly variable we should test a worst-case 5–10% hit-rate.
- Batching latency tradeoff: batch window is user-configurable. For pilot we recommend 150ms to hit batch=6 under your traffic profile; if the UX requires sub-120ms p95 we'll tighten batching and adjust tokens/$ accordingly.
- Dedicated vs hosted: pilot on hosted is faster to start; for MAP close we can include a reserved capacity appendix for predictable unit economics.

Proposed MAP timeline (updated):
- Sept 6–8: preflight sampling + tokenization (owner: Ben)
- Sept 9–15: pilot evaluation (quality & perf)
- Sept 16: procurement packet handed off (procurement window: Sept 13–17)
